name: Brinks Home
notes: Researched from public Brinks Home Help Center articles, the FAQ page and the public Customer Portal sign-in page only (never signed in, never started a guest payment). Sign-in (Azure B2C) shows Email address and Password, Sign in, Forgot your password? and sign up now. One-time payments: Customer Portal, guest payment (Customer Support > Make Payment > Pay as a Guest, then a verification code to phone or email that expires in 10 minutes; the code step is not expressible and not modelled), app, SMS reply, chat, phone 469-391-4024 (convenience fee, amount unpublished) and mail (Brinks Home Security Funding LP, Dept CH 8628, Palatine IL 60055-8628). Guest takes card or ACH. A payment cannot be made on a $0.00 balance. AutoPay enrollment is in the portal (draft day and method can be changed); unenrolling is only by contacting Support (text 469-513-8685 or call 469-391-4024), so autopay_cancel is unsupported online. Paper statements cost $5.99/month (removed by paperless); not modelled as an engine fee. Due-date changes are discussed with Support by text (How to Find Your Billing Due Date; in help). The cancellation article seen in catalog research (call 469-391-4024; signed documents within 7 days; cancels 30 days after processing or at contract end) now returns 404, so cancel_service is phone-only with the documented early-termination-fee FAQ as source (inferred channel). Plan prices are not published, so the plan page keeps the family's synthetic plans. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (independent review): all cited Help Center pages re-read; added the registration article (password rule: lowercase, uppercase, number or special character, 8+ characters) and the chat/text-to-pay line 469-482-9315; due-date wording aligned with the article (eligibility and options, not case by case).

help.title: Ways to make a payment
paragraphs: Signed in to the Customer Portal, open Make a Payment. Without signing in, open Customer Support on brinkshome.com, choose Make Payment and then Pay as a Guest; a verification code is sent to your phone or email and expires after 10 minutes. Guest payments take credit or debit cards and ACH bank transfers.

In the Brinks Home app, open the menu, choose My Account and then Make a Payment. If you have a saved payment method and are not on AutoPay, you get a text 3 days before the bill and can reply to pay.

You can also pay through chat (the chat bubble on the Help Center or a text to 469-482-9315), with a Support Representative at 469-391-4024 (a convenience fee applies), or by mail to Brinks Home Security Funding LP, Department CH 8628, Palatine, IL 60055-8628. A payment cannot be made when the balance is $0.00.

help.title: Enroll in AutoPay
paragraphs: In the Customer Portal, choose AutoPay Enrollment from the left-hand navigation and follow the prompts. In the app, open My Account and then AutoPay Settings.
If you are already enrolled, the page says so and lets you change your draft day or payment method.
AutoPay cannot be switched off in the portal. To unenroll, contact Support: text 469-513-8685 any time or call 469-391-4024.
steps: Sign in to the Customer Portal.
Follow the prompts to pick a payment method and draft day.

help.title: Paperless billing and the paper statement fee
paragraphs: Customers who get paper statements are charged $5.99 a month to cover printing and mailing. Enrolling in paperless billing removes the charge, and statements stay available online.
In the Customer Portal, choose Paperless Billing, verify your email address, choose to enroll and confirm. In the app, open My Account and then Paperless Billing.

help.title: Your bill and payment history
paragraphs: Your statement shows your customer number, the payment due date and the total due, with itemized charges such as 24-hour monitoring, a cost recovery fee and tax. It can also show equipment, past-due amounts, credits, permit and technician charges.
In the Customer Portal, open Billing and scroll to Statements to download a statement as a PDF. Payment History lists payments and credits but not the statements themselves.
To ask about changing your due date, text a Support Representative at 469-513-8685, who can go over eligibility and options.

help.title: Cancel monitoring
paragraphs: Call Customer Support at 469-391-4024 (Monday to Saturday, 8am to 8pm CT) to cancel.
Brinks Home may charge an early termination fee as set out in your monitoring contract. If you financed equipment, you still owe any remaining balance under that financing contract.
